triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in area:cloud · domain:ui · Bug · p2 · pm:queue · size S; rationale: the in-app AI's 确认修改 card shows the raw English `discard_draft` row, styled as a change rather than a removal. That is wrong shipped user text, so p3 → p2. Premise check at claim: the build agent is being retired (objectstack#37720 merged; cloud#5024 and cloud#5046 open). If `discard_package_drafts` leaves the in-app surface with it, close this card as not planned with that reading. Audit restatement, tier 3. Recorded 2026-11-27T09:18Z.

repo:objectstack#6 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjQkY5yXZrN9BEA3rEK

Closing as not planned, on the premise check triage asked for at claim.

`discard_package_drafts` left the in-app surface with the build agent. On cloud `main` the name now appears only in `BUILD_ONLY_TOOL_NAMES` (`packages/service-ai-studio/src/tools/ask-tool-manifest.ts`), the frozen list of retired tool rows every boot withdraws from `sys_metadata` (cloud#5046). No kernel registers it and the ask mount does not bind it, so no chat can produce a `discard_draft` row for the 确认修改 card to draw, and the platform tool registry has no live cloud tool to list.

If a future in-app tool brings back draft discard, a new card should name that tool's own verb and registry entry.

Closed 2026-11-28T00:11Z.
